objectives.description: Extract per-directory detection into a function with counters as parent-shell globals
Preserve fast path byte-identical when package.json exists at cwd
Add bounded vendor-excluded find fallback via process substitution
Cap discovered projects at 10 with loud truncation notice
Prefix discovered-project output lines with relative directory
Preserve terminal no-project SKIP behavior when fallback finds nothing
Malformed-package.json policy: exit 1 at cwd, warn+skip for nested
Re-check set -euo pipefail interactions on new paths
Update script header comment describing two-tier detection
